excluded_candidates.reason: This is a tokenizer-vocabulary augmentation for gene symbols, not a distinct source object or carrier path separate from the ordinary text-prompt route. The paper describes gene symbols being added so they can be read and generated as atomic tokens, but the actual model input remains text.
excluded_candidates.evidence_quote: we augment the base tokenizer with the same canonical human gene symbols used for the 19,260-gene expression panel.
